limitations: Constants are nonoptimal, theorem is in Euclidean dimension three, and sharpness is for weak barriers rather than physically opaque barriers.
scientific_integrity: Theorem proved from projection inequality, finite spherical harmonic inversion, and geometric angular separation; all constants explicit. No claim to classify opaque barriers or certify novelty against inaccessible unpublished literature.
title: Linear facet-angle stability for weak barriers of every spatial convex polytope
